content_blocks.label: lead_paragraph
content_blocks.text: Conservative groups across the country are rallying against the proposed Green New Deal, arguing that it will stifle economic growth and job creation.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_1
content_blocks.text: The plan, which aims to transition the economy to renewable energy sources and create millions of green jobs, has garnered support from progressive politicians and environmental activists.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_2
content_blocks.text: However, critics claim that the initiative will increase taxes and impose unnecessary burdens on businesses and individuals.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_3
content_blocks.text: Proponents counter that the long-term benefits of a sustainable economy far outweigh the short-term costs.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_4
content_blocks.text: The debate over the Green New Deal highlights the deep divisions within the American political landscape.
